waterClimate.description: Water-soil and climate scores for three illustrative rotations. Pest and market pillars are outside this file.

scoreMethod.water: score = 5 * (max net irrigation - scenario net irrigation) / (max - min) across the three scenarios. A score of 5 is only the lowest demand in this set.
scoreMethod.climate: score = 5 * (1 - fraction of cycle days in heat-risk or dry-quartile calendar months).
scoreMethod.rainfallProduct: POWER PRECTOTCORR because IMERG millimetres were not available without Earthdata Login.

scoreScale.direction: Higher means lower estimated net irrigation demand than the other scenarios in this file.

pillars.summary: Red bean then maize needs about 433.152 mm of net irrigation in this POWER climatology (806.143 mm ETc and 414.761 mm effective rain). Soil moisture, slope, and texture are missing, so the soil part of the pillar is not scored.

methodology.monthly: Arithmetic mean of eligible published ordinal weeks, within exact crop/variety/grade/unit series; no interpolation
methodology.seasonality: Median across at least 3 complete years of (monthly mean / mean of 12 monthly means)*100; each month requires >=3 weeks; partial years excluded
methodology.missing: Zero, blank or invalid price means missing, never a free product; ambiguous periods excluded; conflicting duplicates excluded
methodology.normalization: Only explicitly weighted 100/125 lb sacks converted to DOP/lb; quintal kept as published; grades and forms separate

limitations: Santo Domingo wholesale reference, not San Juan farm-gate prices or income
Ordinal weeks do not identify exact observation dates; no day or ISO week is inferred
Nominal prices; annual ratios reduce level shifts but do not constitute inflation adjustment or causal seasonality
No forecast, yield estimate, profit guarantee or recommended harvest date
Source typos, grade changes, incomplete years and unvalidated outliers remain; no calibrated confidence available
Market score must remain null pending agronomic, licensing and data quality review by Frainer

pestRule.source: Oviedo, F. IDIAF, Compendio de habichuela, 2013, pp. 88, 94, 102
pestRule.rule: Habichuela seguida de maíz: rotación con no hospedero citada para antracnosis, bacteriosis común e insectos de habichuela. No generalizar a todas las plagas ni a leguminosas sin identificar.
